mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox (aggregate_id, event_type, payload) VALUES (#{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}::jsonb)
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_id, event_type, payload::text AS payload, retry_count FROM outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= now() ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE outbox SET status = 'DEAD' WHERE id = #{id}
